text: A six-week trial of 48 older adults found daily walks cut blood pressure about 3 points in non-medicated people.
Coffee's memory boost was tested only in mice, at a dose equal to eight cups a day.
A Chinese call-centre firm's home-working volunteers gained 13 percent productivity, mostly from taking fewer breaks.
The new bridge saves northside drivers about four minutes on average, measured during school holidays.
Mixed-quality trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds only in deficient people, about one fewer cold per 30 people yearly.
A four-week reading app test improved letter recognition but not story comprehension, in children already with tutors.
In lab bee colonies, a pesticide at ten times field doses shortened foraging trips but did not kill colonies.
A four-day week trial among volunteer firms, with no comparison group, cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
